blurb.text: A southern Córdoba appellation, bounded by the Genil, Guadajoz and Guadalquivir rivers. It makes mainly sweet dessert wines using sherry-style methods: flor yeast aging and a solera system. The flor gives a dry character and almond notes, and Pedro Ximénez is among the allowed grapes.
